digest.component_or_area: E2 structured-output evaluation harness and CI workflow
propositions: A parameterized test harness under tests/external/ must capture raw LLM replies for each (provider, model, directive-variant) cell across Anthropic, Bedrock, and OpenAI, scoring parse success and layout-class distributions deterministically against committed E2 golden fixtures.

The CI workflow (structured-output-baseline.yml) must be operator-triggered (workflow_dispatch), enforce a predeclared per-run call-budget cap (default 300), and skip unmeasured cells (missing credentials) without failing the job.

The sentinel directive should increase parse success and shift raw-output layout from fenced/multi-object to 100% prose on Anthropic and Bedrock, measurable via before/after score table with n=20 per cell.

Unit tests must validate scorer golden-count correctness on committed fixtures, credential-absent skip paths, and call-budget enforcement; the live workflow run produces an artifact bundle (raw replies + score_table.json) attested by the operator.

Missing workflow registration (tests/unit/test_workflow_names.py) and missing dev dependencies (pytest, pydantic-ai) in the workflow sync caused initial CI failures; fixes applied in patchsets 2 and follow-up change 1417.

Live measurement workflow completed successfully across all 3 provider arms, confirming the sentinel directive collapses layout to prose and raises parse success; unmeasured cells recorded per per-arm secret scoping.
